title: Hexga - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Hexga in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: An ice-bodied Nevron. Ice is the weakness and Fire is resisted, the reverse of what its appearance suggests.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toIce
ResistsFire
AbsorbsNone
ImmuneNone

Bring Ice damage. Fire is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: How to Beat the Hexga
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Ice is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It resists Fire, so that damage is halved.
